title: Fire-damaged industrial greenhouse renovation
summary: Complete renovation of a 16 × 40 m industrial greenhouse damaged by fire. The structure, glazing, and ventilation were restored so the facility could return to production.
body:
Project snapshot
- Size: 16 m × 40 m (640 m²)
- Location: Client site (Mellanå), Sweden
- Delivery: Assessment, selective demolition, engineered repairs, recladding, ventilation refurbishment, and commissioning

Scope of works
- Inspection for heat and fire damage across the frame
- Safe removal of damaged polycarbonate from roof, walls, and roof vents
- Supply and installation of new 16 mm multiwall polycarbonate panels, flashings, and fasteners
- Installation of a large gate and a glazed service door
- Commissioning, testing, and pre-handover adjustments

Engineering
- Reinforced main vertical load-bearing columns
- Rebuilt damaged wall sections with 60×60 aluminium profiles
- Reused undamaged vertical profiles to reduce waste

Ventilation
- Inspected roof ventilation mechanisms and tested motor operation
- Delivered a new control box for ventilation management
- Replaced degraded polycarbonate with 16 mm multiwall sheeting

title: Reo industrial greenhouse installation
summary: End-to-end installation of a 2,250 m² Reo industrial greenhouse at the Mellanå site, from structure to climate, heating, and irrigation commissioning.
body:
Project at a glance
- Size: 25 m × 90 m (2,250 m²)
- Model: Reo Industrial (plastic-covered)
- Scope: Complete site installation of structure, systems, and automation

Integrated technical solutions
- Reinforced framework: arches, end walls, and stabilization for high-capacity loads
- Double-layer plastic covering, tensioned to limit air leakage
- Side and top opening mechanisms with industrial gear motors
- Weather station and sensors for temperature, humidity, and ventilation
- Heating and air circulation for uniform growing conditions
- Irrigation boom and distribution pipework

Engineering notes from the live page

- Hot-dip galvanized columns and trusses
- Double-inflated roof film and 10 mm UV-treated polycarbonate front walls
- Side openings driven by mechanical gear motors
- Weather station with wind and rain sensors

title: Greenhouse renovation in Makan, Sweden
summary: Full renovation of a 40-year-old glass greenhouse in Sweden: dismantled to the foundation, new steel frame on the original base, polycarbonate glazing, and new gutters.
body:
Norhage Industri completed a full renovation of an aging 40-year-old glass greenhouse in Sweden. The old structure was dismantled down to the foundation and replaced with a modern steel frame fitted to the original base. Durable polycarbonate glazing was installed for insulation and lower maintenance, with new gutters for long-lasting protection.
